title: observability: splunk-hec-forwarder-and-atomic-rollback-operator
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Private installs currently lack a standardized, rollback-safe path for introducing external log sinks (Splunk HEC) and corresponding observability stack changes. This PR adds a configurable Splunk HEC forwarder integration, upgrades our observability Helm chart to be rollback-atomic, and introduces a lightweight Rollback Operator that coordinates pre/post-helm hooks for state snapshot/restore of Prometheus and Grafana. The change set spans Helm, Terraform, and the installer operator so tenants can enable Splunk forwarding without risking dashboard or metrics loss on failed upgrades. Key design points: 1) Splunk forwarder implemented as an optional Vector-based sidecar DaemonSet that can be toggled via values.observability.splunk.enabled and configured with sealed secret + KMS-backed secret rotation. 2) Terraform module observability now exposes observability_namespace and splunk_hec_endpoint variables and conditionally provisions RBAC and network policy rules for VPC-restricted HEC endpoints. 3) Helm chart changes introduce an observability-prebackup Job and observability-postrestore Job triggered via Helm hooks; the Rollback Operator watches HelmRelease annotations (installed by the installer) and, on failed upgrades, runs the postrestore with a locked operation to restore Prometheus TSDB snapshots and Grafana provisioning state, then reconciles the log-forwarder state. 4) Dashboard promotion flow: dashboards added to charts/dashboards/promoted are pushed to a tenant-specific Grafana folder via the sidecar; promotion includes a dry-run flag and semantic versioned metadata to avoid unintentional overwrites. 5) Alerts: We add a templated PrometheusRule which defaults to a conservative alert evaluation window and includes tenant tagging for routed alertmanager grouping. Security: Splunk HEC credentials are stored as sealed-secrets; installer wiring adds optional KMS key reference for cloud KMS or a path for HSM-backed secrets in air-gapped installs. Migration plan: This PR includes an upgrade playbook that runs preflight checks (disk enough for snapshot, available replicas) and an automated verification step that queries Prometheus for target scrape health and runs a dashboard checksum compare. Testing: Unit tests for helm templates, an e2e in the private CI that validates a simulated failed upgrade path and verifies rollback restores Prometheus targets and dashboard folder contents. Checklist: - [x] Helm templates and hooks implemented - [x] Terraform variables and docs updated - [x] Rollback Operator prototype + CRD + controller tests - [x] Sealed-secret + KMS wiring documented - [x] Upgrade playbook and runbook added - [x] e2e verification job in CI
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add Vector Splunk HEC forwarder as optional component + values and secret templates; 2) observability chart: prebackup/postrestore helm hooks, dashboard sidecar enhancements, PrometheusRule templating; 3) terraform/module: observability variables and RBAC/network-policy; plus Rollback Operator controller and tests
review_comments: Evan Kim: Can we avoid DaemonSet in air-gapped environments by making the forwarder a sidecar on the log-aggregator? Also add a note about HEC endpoint cert validation.

Maya Patel (author): We added values.observability.splunk.deploymentMode with options [daemonset, sidecar] and documented cert validation. For air-gapped installs the default will be sidecar attached to the existing log-aggregator deployment.
Lina Gomez: Rollback Operator looks promising. Please add a leader-election and annotation-based semaphore so two controllers don't run concurrently in HA setups.
Maya Patel (author): Added a lease-based leader election and annotation lock. Tests updated to simulate concurrent reconcile loops.
Theo Rains: CI flaky test in private e2e: 'prometheus snapshot restore step' times out occasionally. Recommend increasing timeout and surface a retry metric.
Maya Patel (author): Increased snapshot restore timeout from 5m to 15m and added a retriable job wrapper. CI rerun is green.
merge: merged by Lina Gomez using squash merge. Commit message: observability: add Splunk HEC forwarder and rollback operator; closes ENG-4921. Migration notes are in docs/private-installer/observability-splunk-hec.md
release_notes: Add optional Splunk HEC forwarder (Vector) with sealed-secret + KMS support; introduce Rollback Operator to ensure safe rollback of Prometheus TSDB and Grafana provisioning state; new Terraform observability variables (observability_namespace, splunk_hec_endpoint); see docs/private-installer/observability-splunk-hec.md for upgrade playbook and runbook.
